description:
LOCATED AT JEFF WYLER VOLVO CARS OF DUBLIN
This 2024 Volvo XC90 Ultimate represents a refined choice for those seeking a three-row luxury SUV that delivers both capability and sophistication.

- Perforated Nappa Leather Upholstery
- Heated & Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Heated rear seats
- Power moonroof
- Navigation System
- harman/kardon Premium Audio System with 14 Speakers
- Apple CarPlay
- Heads-Up Display
- Heated steering wheel
- Auto-dimming Rear-View mirror
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Emergency communication system: Volvo Cars App with 4 Year Subscription
- All-Wheel Drive with 2.0L Turbocharged Engine
- Protection Package Premier with All-Weather Floor Mats, Bumper Cover, Cargo Tray, First Aid Kit, and Wheel Locks
- Luggage Cover

The interior presents a carefully considered environment where comfort and technology converge. Premium leather seating spans the cabin with heating and ventilation for front occupants, while rear passengers enjoy heated seats as well. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the harman/kardon Premium Audio System with fourteen speakers ensures your music sounds exactly as intended. Apple CarPlay integration keeps you connected to what matters, and the Heads-Up Display projects essential information directly into your line of sight for safer driving.

Climate control extends throughout the vehicle with automatic temperature management, dual-zone control for front and rear, and rear air conditioning that ensures all three rows remain comfortable regardless of weather. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of refinement during colder months, and the auto-dimming rearview mirror adapts to changing light conditions.

Safety receives comprehensive attention across this model. Multiple airbag systems, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to protect occupants. The emergency communication system with Volvo Cars App subscription provides an additional layer of security, while the rear parking camera aids in maneuvering.

Practical elements prove equally important. The Protection Package Premier bundles All-Weather Floor Mats, bumper cover, cargo tray, first aid kit, and wheel locks for comprehensive vehicle care. The luggage cover secures cargo while maintaining the clean lines of your exterior. Split folding rear seats and integrated rear child seats adapt to your varying needs.

The 2.0L turbocharged engine delivers responsive performance while returning 20 miles per gallon in city driving and 26 on the highway. All-Wheel Drive provides assured traction, and steering wheel-mounted controls keep navigation intuitive. With 19,949 miles on the odometer, this vehicle remains essentially new.

We invite you to visit and experience this XC90 Ultimate firsthand to confirm that it meets your expectations.
